verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is a vector and full-text search database. A database could plausibly offer user-configured scheduled jobs or triggers, so this story applies, but the evidence shows no documented way to set up recurring or autonomous automations. The `Prefer: respond-async` header only lets a single API operation run in the background. Automatic index tuning and incremental indexing are internal engine behavior. Neither is an automation the user sets up, so both count only as adjacent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
